title: CMD Kerala Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 02 Public Relations Officer and Executive Engineer Posts
description: Centre for Management Development Kerala (CMD Kerala) has released the official notification for 2026. To fill up the vacancies for 02 Public Relations Officer and Executive Engineer Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech in Civil Engineering or any degree can use this opportunity and apply for the CMD Kerala Notification 2026 . Here we provide more details about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these post...
